_comment: Generated by scripts/gen-bridge-config.sh from .env -- do not hand-edit
config.json, regenerate it. Peers that share a `group` replicate with each
other, so each vault gets exactly one couchdb peer and one storage peer in
its own group. `includeInternal` is deliberately absent: .obsidian stays
out of sync, which is the decision recorded in docs/runbook.md.
